name: Kitbitz
summary: Free CC0 library of 2,000+ hand-drawn illustrations in 13 themed kits, downloadable as SVG and PNG or usable via Figma and MCP.
description: A free library of hand-drawn, mix-and-match illustrations organized into themed kits (City, Cyberpunk, Dungeon, Space, Nature …). Browse and download SVG or PNG, work in Figma with the kits and plugin, or let an AI client search the catalogue via a public MCP server. All illustrations are CC0.
contains: 13 themed kits: Barbieland, City, Cyberpunk, Dungeon, Halloween, Space, Winter …
13 kits on Figma Community plus a Figma plugin
